teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Teams group people for conversations, assignments and reports.
teams.emptyMessage: Create a team and add the people who work together. You can route conversations to it and assign contacts, companies and deals to its members.
teams.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}

how.one: Name a team (for example Sales), pick a colour, and add the people who work together.
how.two: Use it for conversations (route new chats to it, or assign a chat by hand), for records (assign contacts, companies and deals to its members) and for reports.
how.three: A manager is the person who leads the team. A parent team puts it under another team, so you can build a tree such as Sales and Sales West.
how.four: A person's primary team is their main team, kept for reports (reports start to use it in a coming release). Routing, assignment and visibility use every team a person is on.
